run.name: Checks
run.display_title: release: publish VibeLens v0.11.0 graph and API observation fixes

head_commit.message:
release: publish VibeLens v0.11.0 graph and API observation fixes

Fit visible nested groups and labels in shared 2D/3D geometry, picking,
routing and camera bounds without discarding personal positions.
Qualify API runtime projections by handler source, method and route;
preserve original capture identities and exact Graph/Timeline lifecycles.
Extract verified docstrings/JSDoc and require source/API coverage checks
through kickoff and later coding iterations. Add bounded source proximity.

Retain original business/state engines and example baselines. Include
failed checks, repairs, full verification, actual browser regressions,
four live database adapters and clean frozen-export acceptance evidence.
Freeze the complete GitHub-installable Skill archive for v0.11.0.
The fresh GitHub-installed dialogue follows this publication separately.
